Subject: Quick 15-min tech check before demo

Hi Naomi,

We signed up for Redwood's self-serve last week and are lining up a full product demo with our product team. Before the full demo, our infra/ops lead would like a very short technical checkpoint (15 minutes) to confirm a couple of things so the demo can focus on product fit:

- Network integration: VPC peering options and whether we can route inference traffic through our private VPC
- Data handling: brief confirmation on how request logs and KV-cache data are retained/rotated
- On-prem connectors: any supported patterns if we keep models/private data on-prem

Would someone on your side be available for a 15-minute slot today or tomorrow PST? We can do 10:30–11:00 PDT today or 14:00–15:00 PDT tomorrow. If helpful, I've attached a simple infra diagram.

Thanks,
Jordan
